# Company Foundations

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Aava-Aasa-Khora"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Aava-Aasa-Khora. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Aava-Aasa-Khora
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Old Houses" >= 1
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Aava-Aasa-Khora, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"
			action
				payment -650000
				set "cf: active"
				set "cf: autopay"
				set "cf: tax model v2"
				"cf: save schema" = 2
				set "cf: station economics v2"
				set "cf: shuttle"

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Albatross"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Albatross. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Albatross
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Pirate" >= -20
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Albatross, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000

				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`

						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Alfheim"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Alfheim. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Alfheim
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Alfheim, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Antipode"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Antipode. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Antipode
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Syndicate" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Antipode, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`

				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000

						"credits" >= 3500000

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Araio"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Araio. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Araio
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Avgi" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Araio, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000

						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Bailey"

	minor
	source Bailey
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Pirate" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Bailey, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Bivrost"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Bivrost. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Bivrost
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Bivrost, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"
			action
				payment -650000

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Buccaneer Bay"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Buccaneer Bay. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "Buccaneer Bay"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Pirate" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Buccaneer Bay, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Bunthro"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Bunthro. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Bunthro
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Bunrodea (Guard)" >= 500
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Bunthro, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000

				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display

	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Chiron. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Chiron
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Chiron, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Crossroads"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Crossroads. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Crossroads
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Syndicate" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Crossroads, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"
			action
				payment -650000
				set "cf: active"

		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Dancer, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Darkmetal"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Darkmetal. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Darkmetal
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Hai" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Darkmetal, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000

				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline

	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Deli Kasi. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "Deli Kasi"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Bunrodea" >= 10
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Deli Kasi, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display

				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`

		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Echo, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

	name "Found Company"

	description "Found a small company headquartered on Essime. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Essime
	to offer

		"reputation: Gegno Vi" >= 1
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Essime, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`

	name "Found Company"

	source Farseer

		not "cf: active"

	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Farseer, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Featherweight"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Featherweight. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Featherweight
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Featherweight, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display

			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Gemstone"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Gemstone. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Gemstone
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Gemstone, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000

				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Geyser"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Geyser. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Geyser
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Geyser, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000

				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`

					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Heartland"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Heartland. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Heartland
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Heartland, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000

				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"

					decline

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Helheim"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Helheim. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Helheim
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Helheim, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Hermes"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Hermes. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Hermes
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 10
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Hermes, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Hippocrates"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Hippocrates. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Hippocrates
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Syndicate" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Hippocrates, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000

				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Kasii-Tuur-Saqru"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Kasii-Tuur-Saqru. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Kasii-Tuur-Saqru
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: People's Houses" >= 2
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Kasii-Tuur-Saqru, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display

	description "Found a small company headquartered on Kort Vek'kri. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "Kort Vek'kri"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Wanderer" >= 2
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Kort Vek'kri, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Lagrange"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Lagrange. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Lagrange
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Quarg" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Lagrange, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"
			action
				payment -650000
				set "cf: active"
				set "cf: autopay"

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Leviathan Station"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Leviathan Station. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "Leviathan Station"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 10
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Leviathan Station, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display

				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display

						"credits" >= 3500000

	name "Found Company"

	source Maelstrom

	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Maelstrom, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Syndicate" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Maker, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`

	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Mani, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Mars"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Mars. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Mars
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Mars, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display

				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Melenci"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Melenci. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Melenci
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Bunrodea" >= 50
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Melenci, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"

					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"

					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"

	name "Found Company"

	source "Nearby Jade"

		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Coalition" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Nearby Jade, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: New Iceland"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on New Iceland. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "New Iceland"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on New Iceland, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: New Kansas"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on New Kansas. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "New Kansas"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on New Kansas, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`

		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on New Sahara, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: New Tibet"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on New Tibet. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "New Tibet"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on New Tibet, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"

					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50

	name "Found Company"

	source "New Wales"

		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on New Wales, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Nimbus"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Nimbus. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Nimbus
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Syndicate" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Nimbus, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display

			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display

			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Oasis, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Pelubta Station"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Pelubta Station. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "Pelubta Station"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Coalition" >= 20
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Pelubta Station, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000

				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display

						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Poisonwood"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Poisonwood. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Poisonwood
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 2
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Poisonwood, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display

				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Pugglemug"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Pugglemug. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Pugglemug
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Pug" >= 2
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Pugglemug, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000

				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000

						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Reunion"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Reunion. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Reunion
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Syndicate" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Reunion, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"
			action
				payment -650000
				set "cf: active"
				set "cf: autopay"

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Rusty Second"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Rusty Second. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "Rusty Second"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Coalition" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Rusty Second, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000

					to display

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Second Viridian"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Second Viridian. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "Second Viridian"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Coalition" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Second Viridian, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000

					to display

						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Separa Tiklar"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Separa Tiklar. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "Separa Tiklar"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Korath" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Separa Tiklar, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"
			action
				payment -650000

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Serpens"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Serpens. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Serpens
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Serpens, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000

				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display

						"combat rating" >= 50

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Siedi"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Siedi. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Siedi
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Gegno Vi" >= 1
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Siedi, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Sinter"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Sinter. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Sinter
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Sinter, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000

				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display

						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Skyfarm"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Skyfarm. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Skyfarm
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Hai" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Skyfarm, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"
			action
				payment -650000

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Solace"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Solace. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Solace
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Solace, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display

	minor
	source "Starting Rubin"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Coalition" >= 10
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Starting Rubin, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Sundive"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Sundive. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Sundive
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Syndicate" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Sundive, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000

				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"

					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"

					decline

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Sunracer"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Sunracer. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Sunracer
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Syndicate" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Sunracer, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000

						"credits" >= 900000

						"credits" >= 1250000

						"credits" >= 3500000

		"reputation: Coalition" >= 0
	on offer

			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Tebuteb's Table, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Thilos"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Thilos. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Thilos
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Avgi" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Thilos, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"

					decline

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Thrall"

	source Thrall

		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Thrall, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Thule"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Thule. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Thule
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Pirate" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Thule, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"
			action

	description "Found a small company headquartered on Tschyss. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Tschyss
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Gegno" >= 1
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Tschyss, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"
			action
				payment -650000
				set "cf: active"
				set "cf: autopay"
				set "cf: tax model v2"
				"cf: save schema" = 2
				set "cf: station economics v2"
				set "cf: shuttle"
				set "cf: ship available: Shuttle"
				set "cf: manual"
				set "cf: manual pending"
				"cf: hq id" = 329
				set "cf: known planet: Tschyss"
				set "cf: known system: Oosuoro"
				"cf: hq offer mining local value" = 179
				"cf: hq offer trading local value" = 100
				"cf: hq offer trading local optimized value" = 140
				"cf: hq offer security local rate" = 1000
				"cf: hq offer mining regional value" = 95
				"cf: hq offer mining deep value" = 90
				"cf: hq offer mining frontier value" = 90

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Tuur-Aasa-Kaska"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Tuur-Aasa-Kaska. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Tuur-Aasa-Kaska
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Old Houses" >= 1
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Tuur-Aasa-Kaska, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`

	source Uo-Oraa-Vayya

		"reputation: Successor" >= 2
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Uo-Oraa-Vayya, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Vail"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Vail. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Vail
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Republic" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Vail, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000

						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Var' Roi"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Var' Roi. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "Var' Roi"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Wanderer" >= 25
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Var' Roi, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"
			action
				payment -650000

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Vara Ke'sok"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Vara Ke'sok. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "Vara Ke'sok"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Wanderer" >= 5
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Vara Ke'sok, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline

			action

	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Vara Pug. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "Vara Pug"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Pug (Wanderer)" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Vara Pug, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Varu Ek'lak'lai"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Varu Ek'lak'lai. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "Varu Ek'lak'lai"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Wanderer" >= 15
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Varu Ek'lak'lai, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"
			action
				payment -650000
				set "cf: active"
				set "cf: autopay"
				set "cf: tax model v2"
				"cf: save schema" = 2

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Varu K'prai"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Varu K'prai. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "Varu K'prai"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Wanderer" >= 15
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Varu K'prai, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"
			action
				payment -650000
				set "cf: active"

				set "cf: tax model v2"

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Varu Tek'kai"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Varu Tek'kai. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source "Varu Tek'kai"
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Wanderer" >= 15
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Varu Tek'kai, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"
			action
				payment -650000
				set "cf: active"
				set "cf: autopay"

mission "Company Foundations: Registrar: Zenith"
	name "Found Company"
	description "Found a small company headquartered on Zenith. The cheapest charter costs 650,000 credits."
	minor
	source Zenith
	to offer
		not "cf: active"
		"reputation: Pirate" >= 0
	on offer
		conversation
			`A local registrar offers compact company charters for independent captains with enough capital to move beyond one ship. The headquarters would be registered here on Zenith, and the initial staff would work out of rented port offices.`
			`	The cheapest charter is a shuttle company for 650,000 credits. Your account is not ready for registration yet, but the clerk can still explain the paperwork.`
				to display
					"credits" < 650000
			choice
				`	Found a shuttle company for 650,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 650000
					goto "found shuttle"
				`	Found a mining company for 900,000 credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 900000
					goto "found mining"
				`	Found a trading company for 1.25M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 1250000
					goto "found trading"
				`	Found a security company for 3.5M credits.`
					to display
						"credits" >= 3500000
						"combat rating" >= 50
					goto "found security"
				`	Leave the paperwork for another day.`
					decline
			label "found shuttle"
			action
				payment -650000
				set "cf: active"
